integrity: Proof includes a universal coordinate bound, explicit base cases, a repeatable local construction, and a complete five-set argument for the six-vertex exception. A standalone deterministic finite checker tests sizes 4 through 20 exhaustively and explicit witnesses through 600. No claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The exact maximin triple formula concerns only three distinct stable extensions of bidirected paths, not arbitrary attack digraphs or an arbitrary number of extensions. No classification of optimizing triples is given. A differently named prior coding-theoretic result remains a priority risk.
title: Sharp three-viewpoint diversity for stable extensions of bidirected paths
